# lgd-theory

> llms.txt — machine-readable index for AI crawlers. See also README.md and docs/.

## Repository
- title: lgd-theory — Lifecycle Governance Doctrine (全程治理论)
- summary: A governance doctrine for AI and autonomous systems: every self-governing entity carries a registry (有籍), evidence (有证), and evolution gates (有门禁), traceable/provable/accountable across its full lifecycle. Modeled on medical-device lifecycle regulation and generalized to financial AI, autonomous driving, robotics, low-altitude systems, data assets.
- keywords: lifecycle governance, AI governance, AI 治理, 全程治理, 有籍有证有门禁, registry evidence gates, medical device regulation, autonomous systems, SaMD governance, accountable AI, traceability, MCP governance tools, MedXpert, SynomosAI
- author: Zhao Xinghua / Steven Zhao · ORCID 0009-0001-0512-1237
- homepage: https://medxpert.cn
- doi: 10.5281/zenodo.22456647 (concept DOI, covers all versions)
- license: CC BY 4.0

- docs/LGD-GOV-001-Digital-Government-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #3 (digital government) — registry catalogs, audit evidence, public-participation gates across digital administration; CN sources verified, EU AI Act Annex III 5(a) — abstract, three laws (Registry/Evidence/Gates), medical-device reference model, three checks, honest boundaries (中文 + English)

## Key claims (Q&A fodder)
- What is LGD? A doctrine that governance of autonomous things must be a full-lifecycle chain (birth to retirement), not single-point checks.
- What are the three laws? Registry at birth (有籍), evidence for every key act (有证), gates before every evolution (有门禁).
- Where does the model come from? The real-world reference model is medical-device lifecycle regulation (classification/design/risk/registration/clinical/quality/post-market/retirement), generalized to AI.
- Who proposes it? MedXpert × SynomosAI dual brand; Zhao Xinghua / Steven Zhao.
- docs/LGD-CRYPT-001-Onchain-Asset-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #4 (on-chain assets) — FATF R.15/R.16 verified, EU MiCA category
- docs/LGD-FIN-002-Financial-AI-Classification-v1.0.md: domain theory #5 (financial AI risk-tiering) — impact-tier gates table
- docs/LGD-AUT-001-Autonomous-Driving-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #6 (autonomous driving) — CN pilot admission (MIIT 2023/217) verified, L3 permits Dec-2025
- docs/LGD-DAT-001-Data-Element-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #7 (data elements) — CN data-twenty-articles & asset accounting verified
- docs/LGD-UAS-001-Low-Altitude-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #8 (low-altitude/UAS) — State Council/CMC Decree 761 full-chain verified
- docs/LGD-ROB-001-Embodied-AI-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #9 (embodied AI/robotics) — MIIT humanoid guidance & 2025-2026 Gov-Work-Report verified
- docs/LGD-IND-001-Industrial-AI-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #10 (industrial/OT AI) — MLPS2.0 GB/T22239-2019 & CII regulation Decree 745 verified
- docs/LGD-BIO-001-Biomedical-Data-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #12 (biomedical/genetic data) — HGR Decree 717 & ethics review 2023 verified
- docs/LGD-EDU-001-Education-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #13 (education) — UNESCO Beijing Consensus 2019 & MOE digital education verified
- docs/LGD-Lifecycle-Governance-Doctrine-EN-v1.0.md: flagship paper — English full edition (v1.0)
- docs/LGD-Global-Standards-Alignment-v1.0.md: global standards alignment matrix (ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, FDA PCCP, NIST RMF, UNESCO, WHO, FATF, CN/EU/US domain anchors)
- docs/LGD-MED-002-Registration-Methodology-v1.0.md: domain theory #14 (medical-device registration) — registration as projection of full-lifecycle evidence; CN/FDA/EU anchors
